```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r read in data}
obs <- read.csv("data/KBAYKATMKEFJ_2006-2023_Summer_MBM_Observations.csv")
transects <- read.csv("data/KBAYKATMKEFJ_2006-2023_Summer_MBM_Transects.csv")
```

```{r make a single df}

obs <- obs %>%
  mutate(
    site = substr(TripID, 1, 4),
    year = substr(TripID, 8, 11)
  ) %>%
  filter()

species <- unique(obs$Detect_SpeciesCode)
sites <- unique(obs$site)
years <- unique(obs$year)

expand_grid(years, sites, species)

#make transects by site
transects <- transects  %>%
  mutate(
    site = substr(TripID, 1, 4),
    year = substr(TripID, 8, 11)
  )

#might need to eliminate some transects later.... the pelagic ones seem problematic effort wise
unique_transects <- transects %>%
  filter(TransType == "COASTAL") %>%
  distinct(site, year, TXNumber)

```

try new plan
```{r}
obs_summary <-obs %>%
  group_by(year, site, Detect_SpeciesCode) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Count))

transects_summary <- transects %>% 
  group_by(year, site) %>%
  summarise(length = sum(Length_km),
            area = sum(Area_Sampled_km2))

obs_summary <- left_join(obs_summary, transects_summary, by = c("site", "year")) %>%
  rename(species = Detect_SpeciesCode) %>%
  mutate(density = count/area)


years <- unique(obs_summary$year)
sites <- unique(obs_summary$site)
species <- unique(obs_summary$species)

df <- expand_grid(years, sites, species) %>%
  rename(year = years,
         site = sites) %>%
  left_join(., obs_summary) %>%
  select(!c(count, length, area)) %>%
  mutate(density = replace_na(density, 0))
```
find the most common birds to look at
```{r}
birds <- obs %>%
  filter(!Detect_SpeciesCode %in% c("UNCO")) %>%
  group_by(Detect_SpeciesCode) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  head(20) %>% #change this number for more or less species
  pull(Detect_SpeciesCode)
```

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(species %in% birds) %>%
  #mutate(density = scale(density)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_path(aes(year, density, colour = site, group = site)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
df %>%
  filter(species %in% birds) %>%
  mutate(density = scale(density)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_path(aes(year, density, colour = species, group = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~site, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
df %>%

  #mutate(density = scale(density)) %>%

  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_y") +

```
```{r}
mussel_counts <- read.csv("data/KATMKEFJWPWS_2008-2025_Mytilus_20mm_Count.csv")
mussel_size <- read.csv("data/KATMKEFJWPWS_2008-2025_Mytilus_20mm_Size.csv")
seastar_counts <- read.csv("data/KATMKEFJWPWS_2006-2025_Sea_Star_Count.csv")
```

```{r}
mussel_counts %>%
  filter(!BlockName %in% c("EPWS", "NPWS")) %>%
  mutate(Count = as.numeric(Count)) %>%
  group_by(BlockName, SiteName, YearSample) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(Count)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(YearSample, avg, group = SiteName, colour = SiteName)) +
  facet_wrap(~BlockName, nrow = 3) +
  labs(title = "Mussel Counts")
```

```{r}
mussel_size %>%
  filter(!BlockName %in% c("EPWS", "NPWS")) %>%
  mutate(Size = as.numeric(Size)) %>%
  group_by(BlockName, SiteName, YearSample) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(Size)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(YearSample, avg, group = SiteName, colour = SiteName)) +
  facet_wrap(~BlockName, nrow = 3) +
  labs(title = "Mussel Size")
```

```{r}
mussel_counts %>%
  filter(!BlockName %in% c("EPWS", "NPWS")) %>%
  mutate(Count = as.numeric(Count)) %>%
  group_by(BlockName, SiteName, YearSample) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(Count)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(YearSample, avg, group = YearSample)) +
  facet_wrap(~BlockName, nrow = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Mussel Counts",
       y = "Count")
```

```{r}
mussel_size %>%

  ggplot() +

```
